- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- After a price spike (forecast > history peak), model often overshoots; cap forecast at 1–2% above recent high.
- If sentiment is negative (≤ 0.33) and prices are falling, model underestimates; add 0.5–1.5% to forecast to avoid premature bottoming.
- Model consistently underestimates in the first 5–7 days of forecast horizon; apply a 0.5–1.0% upward bias for early days.
- Mean reversion is strong in 30-day horizon; if forecast is > 10% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 5–10%.
- If sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67) and prices are volatile, model overfits short-term noise; smooth forecast by averaging last 3–5 days.
